how: We read the website of every Detroit wedding photographer listed on Lazo (121 listings, 96 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a high-school senior specialist, a studio whose site text belongs to a florist, Windsor and Essex County photographers on the Ontario side, and video-first companies we list under videographers. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you shot a winter wedding here, and what is the plan for portraits when it is dark by 5 and the lawn is under snow?
Can I see a full gallery from one wedding, not highlights, at a venue like mine?
What is the delivery timeline, how many images, and is a second photographer included or an add-on?

picks.name: Kate Diamond Photography
picks.blurb: For the past ten years Kate Diamond has documented what she calls genuine, authentic couples in and around Rochester Hills, with Jessica a long-standing part of the team. Her pitch is anticipating the organic moments that are easy to miss, from portraits through the reception.

picks.name: Chelsea Brown Photography
picks.blurb: Chelsea Brown photographs true-to-life weddings all over Michigan and the Midwest from Ann Arbor, for couples who love some pretty details but are not trying to outdo their friends. The site promises all the calm and all the confidence, with a classic, unscripted style.

picks.name: Rosy and Shaun Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Rosy and Shaun are a husband-and-wife wedding photography team based in Detroit who say photography brought them together but the people keep them coming back. The focus is genuine moments and a comfortable atmosphere on the day, including the moments you never knew happened.

picks.name: Captured by Kelsey Photography
picks.blurb: Kelsey booked her own Ann Arbor wedding photographer by email from Costa Rica in 2009 and regrets how those memories were preserved, which is the experience Captured by Kelsey is built to fix. Aimed at easygoing couples planning elegant weddings, with November and December 2026 and 2027 dates open at our read.

picks.name: Alice Heart Photography | Ann Arbor Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Alice Heart Photography specializes in luxury, fine art and editorial-style weddings, for couples who want fine art storytelling, beautifully edited and effortlessly timeless, in its words. Based in Ann Arbor and working Detroit, with a journal of featured weddings that includes a Matthaei Botanical Gardens proposal story.

picks.name: Galexy Photo
picks.blurb: Alex of Galexy Photo was a cook, landscaper and graphics installer before wedding photography took hold in 2010. Packages are printed on the site: eight hours with an engagement session and online gallery for $2,800, or ten hours plus a 10x10 heirloom album for $4,200, with travel within an hour of Dearborn Heights included.

picks.name: Kari Paine Photography
picks.blurb: Kari Paine photographs weddings in Detroit, across Michigan and anywhere life takes the couple, in a documentary style with plenty of color and whimsy. Kari identifies as queer, and most of the people photographed are queer or allies who want photos that feel alive and a little messy.

picks.name: J & N Studios
picks.blurb: Twenty years of expertise behind a Michigan-based destination wedding photographer who blends editorial and documentary styles for couples who celebrate love in a grand way. J&N Studios, out of Dexter, sets out to capture the candid and crafted portraits and the almost-missed moments alike.

picks.name: Daisy Blue Photography
picks.blurb: Amy Claeys of Daisy Blue describes her work as bold yet whimsical wedding photography for modern, sassy Michigan couples, with robust, colorful, true-to-life images. She found photography in a high school black-and-white film class and came back to it in 2001 after her first child was born. Royal Oak, shooting Michigan and the Midwest.

picks.name: Timeless Moments Studio | Wedding Photography Detroit
picks.blurb: Rami Ajo shoots photo and film as one studio, luxury weddings across Michigan and worldwide from Detroit. He says he pays attention to what lives in between, the glances and the silence, and photographs a wedding close, warm and without a rush.

picks.name: Catchfly Photography
picks.blurb: Catchfly photographs the day as it naturally unfolds with a calm, observant presence, stepping in with gentle direction only when it helps, for couples who do not want to perform for their photos. Editing stays true to color with natural skin tones. Based in Highland Township.

picks.name: Adrienne and Amber Photography
picks.blurb: Best friends and business partners, Adrienne and Amber each hold a photography degree from the College for Creative Studies in Detroit and have worked together since 2012. The Royal Oak studio calls its work refined, editorial and intentional, and every curated collection includes two professional photographers.
